test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Concise
solution:
The correct answer is "**Short**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym for concise is '**short**.'
 
• **Concise** means giving a lot of information in short. 
 
 
• **Example**: *Explain the big bang theory **concisely**.*
 
 
 
• **Short** means small, tiny.
 
 
• **Example**: *Her hairs are **short**.*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let us know about other words.
 
• **Lengthy** means long, elongated
 
 
• **Example**: *This practical is **lengthy***
 
 
 
• **Fine** means very thin.
 
 
• **Example**: *a **thin** sewing thread.*
 
 
 
• **Abrupt** means sudden.
 
 
• **Example**: *The accident happened **abruptly**. *
